responsibility: Definition list of GNAT-specific GCC tree codes. It introduces Ada-only type, expression, reference, and statement nodes such as unconstrained array forms, nonmodular loop arithmetic, and loop/exit statement nodes that are used as intermediate representation during translation from GNAT trees to GCC trees and are recognized by the Ada language hooks and gimplification logic.
same_name_distinction: Defines the Ada-only tree code inventory itself via DEFTREECODE entries, i.e. the canonical list of extra node kinds such as UNCONSTRAINED_ARRAY_TYPE, LOOP_STMT, and EXIT_STMT. Unlike ada-tree.h, it does not declare payload layouts or accessor macros; it supplies the enum-like code definitions that the header then names and manipulates.
